# Rains and measured Rains relative entropy of the Wang-Duan state
#
# r = 0.548
#
#   R(rho^{(x)n})   = min   D(rho^{(x)n} || sigma),  sigma in PPT'
#   R_M(rho^{(x)n}) = max   Tr[rho^{(x)n} log omega],
#                     omega > 0 with some gamma >= omega, ||gamma^{T_B}||_inf <= 1
#   PPT' = {sigma >= 0 : ||sigma^{T_B}||_1 <= 1}.  Both in bits.
#
# R comes from an exactly feasible sigma and is a certified upper bound;
# R_M from an exactly feasible (omega, gamma) and is a certified lower bound.
# R_M <= R always, and both converge to the same limit per copy.
#
# The optimizers are in optimal_operators.npz, block by block in the basis of
# the U(1)^n x| S_n invariant algebra; see verify.py.
